scripts.build: pnpm run generate:announcements && pnpm run generate:git-authors && pnpm run generate:rss && next build
scripts.dev:cloudflare: pnpm run generate:git-authors && NEXTJS_ENV=cloudflare-dev next dev

scripts.deploy: pnpm run generate:announcements && pnpm run generate:git-authors && pnpm run generate:rss && pnpm run generate:ud-subsets && opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm run prune:static-fonts && pnpm run sync:blog-assets && NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first opennextjs-cloudflare deploy && pnpm run purge:announcements-cache
scripts.upload: pnpm run generate:announcements && pnpm run generate:git-authors && pnpm run generate:rss && pnpm run generate:ud-subsets && opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm run prune:static-fonts && pnpm run sync:blog-assets && NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first opennextjs-cloudflare upload
